evals.prompt: Before I add OAuth, investigate how auth currently works in this repo and give me a short brief on the relevant modules, existing patterns, and likely impact.
evals.expected_output: Task-scoped Investigation Brief with structure, patterns, scope boundaries, prior art, and impact-relevant findings; avoids full-repo onboarding or speculative redesign.
assertions: Scopes investigation to auth and the OAuth task
Includes existing patterns and prior art
Does not launch whole-repo onboarding or propose redesigns

evals.prompt: I just cloned this repo and have never seen it. Map the whole repository and any local sibling repos it depends on so I have structural context before my first task.
evals.expected_output: Runs whole-repo-onboarding mode, performs partitioned scanning and optional local sibling-repo topology discovery, writes structural-tagged bootstrap content to the existing persistent cartographer map data, preserving task-verified data precedence.
assertions: Selects whole-repo-onboarding mode rather than default task investigation
Preserves partition completeness/partial-scan reporting and sibling topology behavior
Uses existing persistent map storage and structural markers

evals.prompt: I traced the payment retry flow and found a non-obvious invariant. Check the existing codebase map for payment-module context, then record the verified invariant so future implementers see it.
evals.expected_output: Uses persistent-map mode to consult and record through the existing cartographer storage and recorder workflow, without changing repository source.
assertions: Consults relevant map/module files and landmines before recording
Uses recorder guidance and existing memory paths

evals.prompt: Where are the structural problems in this codebase? Find high-leverage refactor candidates, trace how the leading friction developed, compare competing redesign approaches, and tell me the best next step.
evals.expected_output: Runs improvement-discovery mode with friction discovery, genealogy, analysis, prioritization, and competing proposals; returns selected proposal for /design, without writing design content or modifying code.
assertions: Selects improvement-discovery mode, not task investigation
Distinguishes symptoms from root causes and includes evidence/genealogy
Compares alternatives and prioritizes friction opportunities
Routes selected redesign to /design and does not create design doc itself
